reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream 75ml
reviews.text: The gel texture is nice and absorbs quickly, like with other 1004 products. This one smells minty, much like some neck main medicated gels, which I’m not a fan of for skincare. Also, not to be used around the eye area, irritates skin there. This is weird because it means I need two moisturizers at night…
reviews.zh: 啫喱質地好好，吸收快，同其他 1004 產品一樣。呢款嘅味道有啲似薄荷，好似一啲治頸痛嘅藥用啫喱嗰種，我唔太鍾意用喺護膚上。另外，唔可以用喺眼周，會刺激嗰度嘅皮膚。咁樣好奇怪，因為即係晚上要用兩款保濕霜……

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream 75ml
reviews.text: It’s my second bottle I love this it’s to moisturizing and hydrating. It also has a glowing effect while not being too heavy. It’s very nice for summer and for winter.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第二樽，我好鍾意，佢保濕力太強。仲有啲令人有光澤嘅效果，而且唔會太厚重。夏天同冬天用都好好。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream 75ml
reviews.text: Best moisturizer for my skin! Really nice for acne prone skins and every skin type in general ❤️
reviews.zh: 最適合我嘅保濕霜！對易生痘嘅皮膚都好好，而且一般各種膚質都適合 ❤️

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream 75ml
reviews.text: I bought this cream for the second time. It has a very light texture and absorbs quickly. It has a pleasant, light tea tree scent.
reviews.zh: 我係第二次買呢款面霜。質地好輕，吸收好快。有淡淡嘅茶樹香味，好舒服。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream 75ml
reviews.text: Gel cream formula, nicely hydrating, light scent of tea tree, a little goes a long way. It feels cool and soothing going on, absorbs well, and has been helping my skin stay break-out free during my period!
reviews.zh: 啫喱面霜配方，保濕效果好好，有淡淡嘅茶樹香味，少少就夠用。搽嗰陣有清涼同舒緩嘅感覺，吸收好，喺我經期嗰陣，佢幫助我嘅皮膚冇起痘！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream 75ml
reviews.text: Very cooling and calming! I've been using it like a night cream since it's pretty thick, but it spreads easily. It does smell like tea tree oil but it's not irritating in this formulation for me.
reviews.zh: 好清涼、好舒緩！因為佢幾厚身，我一直當晚霜咁用，不過好容易推開。佢確實有茶樹油嘅味道，但係呢個配方對我嚟講冇刺激性。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream 75ml
reviews.text:
Great for calming and clarifying the skin!
I’ve been loving this Tea-Trica product — it absorbs quickly, feels super lightweight, and instantly soothes any redness or irritation. It keeps my skin balanced without drying it out, and I’ve noticed fewer breakouts and smoother texture since using it. Perfect for sensitive or combination skin. Highly recommend! 💚✨
reviews.zh:
好適合舒緩同令皮膚清透！
我一直好鍾意呢款 Tea-Trica 產品——吸收快，質地超輕盈，即刻舒緩任何泛紅或者刺激。佢令皮膚保持平衡，唔會令佢乾燥，而且由我開始用之後，我留意到痘痘少咗，質地都更加滑。非常啱敏感肌或者混合性皮膚。極力推薦！ 💚✨

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream 75ml
reviews.text: **A pleasant face moisturizer with a herbal scent; it feels light and absorbs nicely.**
reviews.zh: **有草本香味嘅面部保濕霜，感覺輕盈，吸收得好。**

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
